subject.title: [Feature]: Diffs viewer: per-file +/- stats and multi-file summary navigation

question: Should the bundled diffs plugin add SSR per-file stats, changed-files summary navigation, and static-export toolbar suppression now?
rationale: The source path is clear and bounded, but this is a new user-facing viewer/export UX behavior on a protected maintainer-labeled issue, so automation should not choose the product shape unilaterally.

options.title: Approve a focused diffs-plugin PR
options.body: Implement the feature inside `extensions/diffs` using existing `@pierre/diffs` metadata and require focused tests for viewer and static render targets.

options.title: Keep as backlog
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers prioritize diffs viewer ergonomics and export behavior.

options.title: Narrow to stats only
options.body: Add per-file stats while deferring summary navigation or toolbar suppression if those UX choices need separate design review.

recommendation.title: Approve a focused diffs-plugin PR
recommendation.body: Implement the feature inside `extensions/diffs` using existing `@pierre/diffs` metadata and require focused tests for viewer and static render targets.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` opened the issue and is also tied by git history to the current diffs plugin implementation.
